status: DRAFT - not frozen, not audited for freeze, no forward pass authorized
authority: This spec governs where it and PREREGISTRATION.md differ; any difference is a draft-audit defect.
supersedes: nothing; cts-stage0-v1 (tag prereg/cts-stage0-v1, commit 43dd95d3d476a9db9ebb9f8d0aa5639c65a1c1ab) is a stopped registration and stays unchanged

frozen_v1_inputs_by_hash.note: Reused byte-identically. Referenced only by SHA-256; never copied, edited or re-derived. The implementation must verify each hash before use and refuse on mismatch.

model.name: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
model.execution_identity: one identity (GPU model, driver, container image digest, python and package versions, snapshot hashes) for TV-v2 and the whole scientific run; recorded in the TV-v2 report and enforced by every scientific job

L2.definition: Per prompt and per context: one forward over prompt positions 0..L-2 (unsteered) producing a prefix KV cache; per condition, batch 1: forward of position L-1 from a copy of that cache with the condition's hook active, then one flat-packed continuation forward of all answer forms (4D segment mask, explicit position ids, no steering), from which L_w is computed.
L2.applies_to: every condition whose steering acts only at position L-1 (mode last) in a context whose prefix is shared
L2.own_prefix_rule: conditions with mode all_positions, and persona-context conditions, have no condition-independent prefix to share; for them L2 reduces to one full prefill of positions 0..L-1 followed by the same flat-packed continuation (identical to the v1 L1 layout)
L2.coupling: none by construction: every condition is computed at batch 1; the shared prefix is condition-independent at every layer

reference_layout.name: L1
reference_layout.definition: v1 implemented layout at commit 8afd41d: batch 1, full prefill of positions 0..L-1 with the hook, then the flat-packed continuation
reference_layout.use: only for the in-run fragility check (integrity.fragility); never for any gating statistic

execution_layout.baseline_rule: every steered-minus-unsteered or context-minus-default difference is formed between conditions of the same cost class: L2 conditions against the L2 baseline 'unsteered'; own-prefix conditions (PC_pos, its reference, A6 persona contexts) against the own-prefix baseline 'persona:P_default'; L1 re-scores against the L1 re-score of 'unsteered'. No statistic mixes layouts.

prompt_sets.S0_all: all 334 S0 prompts (300 animal-family + 34 non-animal and factual control items)
prompt_sets.S0_animal: the 300 S0 animal-family prompts (direct, identity, hypothetical; 100 each)

inputs.prompt_set_rule: named conditions are scored on S0_all; every null and random-reference condition is scored on S0_animal; every gating statistic uses S0_animal only

not_extracted_in_v2.P_fox_T1: only used by the dropped descriptive fox/owl contrasts; fox stays a scored off-target word
not_extracted_in_v2.P_helpful: rendering descriptor for other studies; not used by any v2 statistic

extraction.slot_definition: slot k = hidden_states[k] = output of decoder block k-1 (0-based); slot 28 after final RMSNorm

directions.pair_contrast: c_{A,B} = unit(t_A - t_B), template T1 unless stated

shared_components.g_anim: unit(mean_{N in null_pool.selected_16} t_{N_T1} - mean(t_chess, t_blue)); held-out animal-generic component built only from the 16 null-pool T1 personas, which share no persona with cat, dog, wolf or A_len (changed from v1, whose g_anim contained t_cat and the A_len axes)
shared_components.span_G: G = column space of the 3584 x 4 matrix [g_anim, g_tmpl, g_id, h] at slot 14 (float64); P_G from its thin SVD, keeping singular vectors with singular value > 1e-6 x the largest; the projector is independent of column order; the retained rank is recorded
shared_components.g_anim_v1_descriptive: unit(mean_{X in A_len + cat} t_X - mean(t_chess, t_blue)); v1 definition, computed and reported descriptively only; never used by TS(f) or any label
shared_components.held_out_principle: every component of G is estimated from personas that do not enter the tested contrast, except h, whose cat content cancels by construction (t_cat - t_qwencat)

leakage_free_contrasts.formula: c_perpG = unit(c - P_G c), P_G the orthogonal projector onto G
leakage_free_contrasts.half_estimates: G and c are rebuilt from the same half means; R(c_perpG) = cos(c_perpG from half 1, c_perpG from half 2)
leakage_free_contrasts.reported: cos(c, P_G c), ||P_G c||, and the share of ||P_G c||^2 per SVD direction and per original component (least-squares coefficients), per contrast

directions.slot27_contrasts_descriptive: c_cat_dog, c_cat_wolf, c_cat_anim rebuilt from slot-27 axes; dose uses tau at slot 27

R_cov.construction: as v1 spec directions.random.R_cov.construction: Sigma_14 = sample covariance (ddof 1) of the 1,024 P_default slot-14 states (float64); z = X_c^T g / sqrt(1023), g ~ N(0, I_1024); numpy.random.default_rng(20260925), g drawn as one (199, 1024) standard_normal array in row order; direction i = unit(z_i)
R_cov.PC_reference: the first 99 R_cov directions in generation order
R_cov.sign_convention: random directions are added with sign +1 only

structured_null.pairs: all 240 ordered pairs (a, b), a != b, of null_pool.selected_16, T1 personas N_a_T1, N_b_T1
structured_null.name: null:{a}>{b} with singular persona stems (e.g. null:bear>deer)
structured_null.statistic: same statistic as the tested contrast, same off-target set, norm-matched to the tested magnitude kappa*|tau(c)|, kappa = 1

intervention.hook: forward hook on decoder block (slot - 1) output
intervention.verification: change is read at every slot > site (not only site + 1)
intervention.position: absolute index prompt_len - 1, prefill only; answer forms are scored without steering

dose.teacher_coordinate: tau(D) = <t_cat, unit(D)> at the site slot, from the extraction prompts, written to a hashed sidecar before any steering; for slot-27 directions t_cat at slot 27
dose.shared_label_dose: |tau(c)| of the compared tested contrast (equal norm to c)
dose.PC_star: unit(t_cat) at magnitude |tau(c)|, per tested contrast
dose.PC_pos: raw t_cat added at every prompt position 0..L-1 at slot 14, prefill only

endpoint.word_score: L_w = log sum_{f in F(w)} P(f tokens then any boundary id | prompt)
endpoint.set_log_odds: l_{w,O} = L_w - logsumexp_{o in O} L_o
endpoint.animal_mass: L_anim = logsumexp over the 12 scored animal words {cat, dog, wolf, lion, horse, rabbit, elephant, fox, owl, turtle, spider, ant}
endpoint.delta: mean over S0_animal prompts of steered minus unsteered, family weights 1/3 each

statistics.bootstrap: identical to v1 spec statistics.bootstrap (prompt unit, stratified by family, fixed weights 1/3, n_boot 10000, numpy.random.default_rng(20260925), one (10000, 100) index matrix per family in order direct, identity, hypothetical, shared by every statistic and condition, type-7 percentile interval at alpha_TS/2 and 1 - alpha_TS/2, a bound equal to 0 does not exclude 0)
statistics.SE_boot: standard deviation (ddof 1) of the 10,000 bootstrap replicates of a statistic

rank_test.structured_null: n = 240, alpha = alpha_TS: pass iff #{T_null >= T_obs} <= 3
rank_test.R_cov: n = 199, alpha = alpha_TS: pass iff #{T_null >= T_obs} <= 2
rank_test.PC_reference: n = 99, alpha = alpha_PC: pass iff #{T_null >= T_obs} <= 3
rank_test.ties: a null equal to T_obs counts as an exceedance

R.statistic: cosine of half-estimates (rows 0-511 vs 512-1023) at slot 14

TS.pass: a and b and c and d1 and d2 and e and f
TS.b: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,O}(+c)) > 0 and CI_high(Delta l_{cat,O}(-c)) < 0; for c_cat_X also CI_low(Delta l_{X,O}(-c)) > 0
TS.c: for every o in O: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,o}(+c)) > 0; for c_cat_X also for every o in O: CI_low(Delta l_{X,o}(-c)) > 0
TS.d1: structured-null rank test on T = Delta l_{cat,O}(+c) passes
TS.d2: R_cov rank test on T = Delta l_{cat,O}(+c) passes (R_cov at magnitude |tau(c)|)
TS.e: for c_cat_dog and c_cat_wolf: point-estimate signs of (b) hold at kappa 0.5 (T1) and with c^T2 and c^T3 at their own kappa 1 doses; for c_cat_anim: at kappa 0.5 (T1) and with c_cat_anim^T3 only
TS.e_c_cat_anim_interpretation: robustness to one independent persona paraphrase (T3) only; never described as multi-paraphrase robustness
TS.f: for c_perpG of the same contrast: R(c_perpG) >= 0.95 and the (b) and (c) conditions hold for c_perpG at its own kappa 1 teacher coordinate
TS.c_cat_anim_off_target: O replaced by O_for_c_cat_anim in b, c, d1, d2, e, f and PC_star_anim
TS.TS_abcde: a and b and c and d1 and d2 and e (reported; used to name the pivot reason)

criteria.PC: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,O_panel}(t_cat)) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS AND PC_reference rank test vs the first 99 R_cov at magnitude ||t_cat|| (mode last) passes
criteria.PC_star: per tested contrast: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,O}(unit(t_cat) at |tau(c)|)) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS (O per contrast)
criteria.PC_pos: PC criterion with t_cat added at every prompt position; reference = the first 99 R_cov added at every position at magnitude ||t_cat||
criteria.A1_A3: decided pre-freeze in v1 ADMISSIBILITY_A1_A3.md (by hash): dog pass, wolf pass-weak

A4.statistic: mean over S0_animal (family weights 1/3) of exp(L_X), unsteered

criteria.A6: unsteered: CI_low(l_{X,O}(P_X_T1 context) - l_{X,O}(default context)) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS, O = O_panel minus X
criteria.A7: CI_low(Delta l_{X,O}(raw t_X)) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS, O = O_panel minus X

order.if: any integrity check fails (including integrity.fragility and a BUDGET_STOP)
(not PC and not PC_pos) or not R_t_cat
first X in candidates.order with A4 and A5 and A6 and A7
TS(c_cat_anim) or TS(c_cat_X) for some X
order.stage2a_primary: c_cat_anim if TS(c_cat_anim) else first passing c_cat_X in candidate order

order.if: none of ranks 1-5, and PC_star fails for all three tested contrasts
none of ranks 1-6, and TS_abcde holds for at least one tested contrast
order.meaning: at least one contrast passes every TS part except f: its selectivity is not separable from the constructed shared components

decision.pivot_consequence: ranks 7 and 8: CTS as designed stops; next steps (DAS or model diffing) need a separate preregistration

labels.PREFERENCE_CONTRAST: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,O}(+c) - Delta l_{cat,O}(+m)) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS, m the matching mention contrast at |tau(c)| (for c_cat_anim: against m_cat_dog and m_cat_wolf both, with O_for_c_cat_anim)

BASE_SHARED_DIRECTION.applies_to: each g in {g_anim, g_tmpl, g_id}, relative to each c with TS(c)
BASE_SHARED_DIRECTION.ii_not_trait_selective: for every o in S(c), with D+_o = Delta l_{cat,o}(+g) - r * Delta l_{cat,o}(+c) and D-_o = Delta l_{cat,o}(+g) + r * Delta l_{cat,o}(+c) computed per paired bootstrap replicate: the type-7 quantile of D+_o at probability 1 - alpha_TS is < 0 AND the type-7 quantile of D-_o at probability alpha_TS is > 0 (two one-sided tests, each at level alpha_TS; equivalent to a (1 - 2 alpha_TS) interval inside the margin)
BASE_SHARED_DIRECTION.S_of_c: for c_cat_X: O_panel minus X, plus X; for c_cat_anim: O_for_c_cat_anim
BASE_SHARED_DIRECTION.r_classification: heuristic smallest effect of interest, inherited from the frozen program value 'carries' = 0.20 (v1 spec stage2a_precommitments.carries); no absolute nat margin is justified by existing evidence
BASE_SHARED_DIRECTION.if_not_assessable: if no c passes TS, the label is NOT_ASSESSABLE for every g
BASE_SHARED_DIRECTION.consequence: label only; constrains Stage-2 wording; never changes the decision

integrity_checks: every frozen_v1_inputs_by_hash file and external input hash matches
render identity test on all 1024 extraction rows
hook unit tests pass in the execution environment (change visible at every slot > site)
no NaN or inf in any stored tensor or score
all extraction rows and all prompts of the assigned prompt set present for every persona and condition
baseline (unsteered, L2) scored twice on different hosts: every form log-prob identical within 1e-4
sidecars carry the execution commit and the execution identity digest
no D or C prompt id appears in any Stage-0 output
runtime re-tokenization reproduces every frozen token id and boundary_ids_sha256
accounting ledger complete and within accounting.scientific.cap

fragility.purpose: decision-level numerical robustness: no gating statistic may depend on the choice between two legitimate batch-1 layouts by more than a fixed fraction of its statistical uncertainty
fragility.reference_rescore: re-scored in L1 on their prompt sets: the L2 baseline, every gating named condition of cost class L2_shared_prefix, and the first 10 conditions in registry order of each of the 7 L2 null families (structured null x 3 magnitudes, R_cov x 3 magnitudes, PC_reference mode last); own-prefix conditions are computed identically in L2 and L1 and are not re-scored (registry flag reference_rescore)
fragility.epsilon_derivation: Monte-Carlo standard error of the percentile-bootstrap CI bound at probability 1 - alpha_TS/2 with n_boot = 10,000, in units of the bootstrap SE, under a normal approximation: sqrt(p(1-p)/B) / phi(z_p) with p = 0.991667, z_p = 2.394, phi(z_p) = 0.0227, B = 10,000, giving 0.040. The frozen design already accepts random imprecision of this size in every CI bound; a deterministic layout shift no larger than it cannot change decisions more often than the bootstrap's own Monte-Carlo noise does.
fragility.criterion_CI_statistics: standardized shift z_S = (S_L2 - S_L1) / SE_boot(S_L2) for every gating or label statistic S computable from re-scored conditions
fragility.criterion_rank_tests: standardized shift z_j = (T_j,L2 - T_j,L1) / SD_F for every re-scored null condition j of family F, SD_F = standard deviation (ddof 1) of the L2 statistics of all members of F
fragility.consequence: any violation: TECHNICAL_FAIL (reason FRAGILITY); not rerunnable, because the cause is not infrastructure
fragility.order: evaluated automatically before any decision criterion is evaluated; the decision JSON then contains only the fragility report
fragility.criterion: pool all m standardized shifts (m is counted and reported by the implementation). PASS iff (1) RMS(z) <= epsilon and (2) max |z| <= epsilon * q_m, q_m = Phi^{-1}(1 - 0.05 / (2 m)). Rationale: (1) compares the typical layout shift with the Monte-Carlo imprecision the design accepts in every CI bound; (2) flags a single gross shift, set so that shifts distributed as N(0, epsilon^2) - the accepted regime - exceed it with probability <= 0.05 over all m statistics

accounting.unit: A100-h = sum over GPU jobs of RemoteWallClockTime (s) x RequestGpus / 3600, read from the HTCondor job ad of every execution attempt; any GPU model counts 1:1

categories.ENG: development and debugging; never forwards S0, D or C prompts; logged, not capped by this prereg
categories.TV: every job of TV-v2 (all attempts); cap 6 A100-h; at most 3 TV-v2 attempts; exceeding either stops TV-v2 and requires a dated researcher decision (TV is outcome-blind, so an extension is a resource decision, not a forking risk)
categories.SCI: every job submitted under the scientific authorization: successful, failed, preempted, retried, infrastructure-failed and integrity-failed jobs alike

scientific.authorization_rule: authorization is refused unless P <= 0.8 * cap, P = projected SCI A100-h from the frozen registry x TV-v2-measured seconds per cost class x TV-v2-measured end-to-end overhead factor
scientific.submit_rule: every scientific submission is refused unless consumed_SCI + remaining_projection <= cap; enforced in code (E4)
scientific.budget_stop: if at any point consumed_SCI + remaining_projection > cap: no further submission; outputs are sealed and not analysed; the decision is TECHNICAL_FAIL (reason BUDGET_STOP); remedy only a new preregistration version
scientific.shard_retry: infrastructure-class failures (preemption, node or GPU fault, scheduler eviction) may be retried at most 2 times per shard; integrity-class failures are final (E1, E2); every attempt counts to SCI
scientific.rerun: at most one rerun of the run for a documented infrastructure cause; it reuses completed, hash-verified shards; it counts to the same cap; the cap is never reset
scientific.rationale: counting every attempt makes the cap a hard property and removes the classification 'infrastructure' as a degree of freedom; the 0.8 planning fraction is the v1 convention, retained as the reserve for shard retries
scientific.pre_authorization_reductions: if the TV-v2 projection P exceeds 0.8 x cap, the following outcome-blind reductions are applied in this order, each only as far as needed, before freeze: (1) drop all descriptive conditions; (2) reduce the fragility null subset from the first 10 to the first 5 members per null family; if P still exceeds 0.8 x cap, v2 is not authorized and the researcher decides (a dated record before freeze) between raising the cap and a new version. No confirmatory condition is ever removed.

accounting.historical: v1 TV, v1 development and Phase F jobs are recorded as historical and count to no v2 category

condition_registry.authority: the generated registry is the complete list of scientific conditions; the implementation must reproduce it byte-identically from this spec (static test)

cost_classes.L2_shared_prefix: steering mode last in the default context: per condition only position L-1 plus the packed continuation
cost_classes.own_prefix: mode all_positions or a persona context: full prefill plus packed continuation
cost_classes.extraction: unsteered prefill of extraction prompts, one per persona and row
cost_classes.L1_reference: fragility re-score in the reference layout

planning_seconds_placeholder.source: Phase F A100 measurements (L1 0.207-0.227 s; prefix-reuse prototype 0.104-0.114 s); extraction per-forward time and the overhead factor are estimates; all are replaced by TV-v2 measurements before authorization

engineering_prerequisites_for_authorizat.E1: failed preflight is final: no retry, and a completion marker with pass=false is refused by every downstream stage
engineering_prerequisites_for_authorizat.E2: error classes: infrastructure -> bounded retry (accounting.scientific.shard_retry); integrity (sentinel, self-test, hash, non-finite, D/C leak, fragility) -> final
engineering_prerequisites_for_authorizat.E3: shard size derived from TV-v2 throughput so that a shard runs <= 0.5 x the retirement time; intra-shard resumption not required
engineering_prerequisites_for_authorizat.E4: code-level budget gate: ledger of every GPU job by category from job ads; submit refused per accounting rules; BUDGET_STOP implemented
engineering_prerequisites_for_authorizat.E5: immutable per-attempt records (cluster.proc.attempt), read by the integrity stage
engineering_prerequisites_for_authorizat.minors: freeze or remove the untested cached-vs-uncached tolerance; hook verification at every slot > site; multi-row real-model self-test; guards recompute pass flags instead of trusting stored ones; write_once without TOCTOU; image check on CPU nodes; venv verified by hash
engineering_prerequisites_for_authorizat.status: all open; required before scientific authorization, not before freeze

tv_v2.prompts: V (cts_stage0_validation_prompts.jsonl, v1, by hash) only; nonce persona and TV-seed directions only; no real persona, panel word, S0/D/C id or scientific direction
checks: execution identity recorded and matched on >= 2 hosts
hook self-test; planted effect at block 13 and block 27 (both reported; the gate is block 27 as in v1 technical validation)
L2 repeat and cross-host bitwise identity
L2 vs L1 fragility estimate on V (descriptive; V has 40 prompts, too few for a gate; see PREREGISTRATION §9.3)
throughput per cost class on S0-length-matched stand-in prompts, steered, and end-to-end overhead factor from a shard dry run
budget projection P from the frozen registry
tv_v2.gate: authorization requires every check to pass and P <= 0.8 * cap
tv_v2.layout_failure: if L2 fails any TV-v2 determinism check, L1 becomes canonical only if its projection satisfies the authorization rule; otherwise v2 is not authorized (researcher decision as in accounting.scientific.pre_authorization_reductions)

sequence: 1 draft (this spec) and independent static audit
2 implementation on a public branch from master (not the v1 lineage), including E1-E5
3 TV-v2 at the execution commit on the execution identity

4 freeze: the only values filled from TV-v2 are the planning seconds per cost class, the overhead factor, the extraction seconds and the execution identity; no scientific parameter may change as a function of TV-v2
5 researcher authorization if P <= 0.8 x cap
6 one scientific execution; automated analysis; independent audit; release
stage2a_precommitments: unchanged from v1 spec stage2a_precommitments, plus: Stage 2a may consume the BASE_SHARED_DIRECTION labels and the c_perpG vectors of passing contrasts; it may not consume doses or prompt-level results
